original: 騙されたと思ってやってみて。

en.text: Try to do that and I think you will be deceived.
Try to do that and I think you will be tricked.
I think if you try it you will be tricked.
I think if you try it you will be deceived.
Try it I think you will be tricked.
Try it I think you will be deceived.
If you try it, I think you'll be deceived.
If you try it, I think you'll be tricked.
